_about: Bugs and limitations we already know about, so the agent can match a report instead of treating it as new. Keep this short and current.

issues.title: No Android app yet
issues.workaround: Domi is iPhone-only during private testing.

issues.title: Signing in with the other provider creates a new empty account
issues.workaround: Sign out and sign in with the same option (Apple or Google) used originally.

issues.title: Old invite links stop working after the member makes a new one
issues.workaround: Ask the person who invited you for a fresh link.

issues.title: App updates install on the next launch, so a fix may need a restart or two
issues.workaround: Close Domi fully and reopen it, twice if needed.

issues.title: Notifications held back by iOS Focus or turned off in Settings
issues.workaround: Check You > Notifications in Domi and iPhone Settings > Notifications > Domi, and any Focus modes.

issues.title: Photos are deleted 30 days after a listing ends (picked up, removed, or expired and not reposted), so old listings show gray boxes
issues.workaround: Expected for listings that ended more than 30 days ago. Active listings keep their photos. To keep a listing's photos, repost it before then.
